goal: Protect inbound network connections from indefinite stalls if an I/O call ever omits non-blocking flags
Ensure accepted sockets are explicitly non-blocking rather than relying on per-call flags or inheritance
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified HTTP, P2P, and I2P paths and confirmed safety against stalls (willcl-ark)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it adds defense-in-depth against peer stalls if a socket call omits non-blocking flags
Current code already passes non-blocking flags per call so there is no active vulnerability

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it hardens the HTTP RPC server against potential thread stalls on Linux
Linux sockets do not inherit non-blocking flags from listeners making defense-in-depth prudent
